description.name: Entry
description.text: One piercing single attack (31.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Extra Mode], [Damage Cap +20000], [Extra Mode: Rinoa (Earth)], [Instant ATB 1], [Attach Earth 3 with Secondary Stacking] to user. Immediately casts [Ability Crash] if Angel Wing is equipped.

description.name: Extra Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses.

description.name: Extra Mode: Rinoa (Earth)
description.text: Increases Earth ability damage by 10/20/30/40/50% at Attach Earth level 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, Extra Abilities trigger 1 additional time (max 5), removed if user hasn't [Extra Mode]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Secondary Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 5, up to Attach Earth 5
